input.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd
import os

# Read the TSV file
input_file = os.path.join(os.environ['INPUT_DIR'], 'met_objects_list.tsv')
df = pd.read_csv(input_file, sep='\t')

# Standardization steps:
# 1. Trim whitespace from all cells
df = df.applymap(lambda x: x.strip() if isinstance(x, str) else x)

# 2. Standardize column names (snake_case)
df.columns = ['object_date', 'title', 'artist_display_name', 'object_number', 'link_resource']

# 3. Replace empty strings with NaN for consistency
df = df.replace('', pd.NA)

# 4. Sort by object_number for consistency
df = df.sort_values('object_number').reset_index(drop=True)

# 5. Save to output
output_file = '/tmp/met_objects_list_standardized.tsv'
df.to_csv(output_file, sep='\t', index=False, na_rep='')

print("Standardization Complete!")
print(f"\nStandardized file info:")
print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")
print(f"Columns: {list(df.columns)}")
print(f"\nFirst 10 rows:")
print(df.head(10).to_string())
print(f"\nMissing values:")
print(df.isnull().sum())
print(f"\nFile saved to: {output_file}")

EOF
